This page is a list of all available '''oils''' in {{TWMS}}. == PRE-1.2.0 == Oils could be crafted using combination of [[The Witcher Monster Slayer ingredients|monster remains]] and [[The Witcher Monster Slayer ingredients|herbs]] gathered from shrubs. [[The Witcher Monster Slayer bestiary|Monsters]] of any level dropped both [[powdered monster tissue]] and [[The Witcher Monster Slayer ingredients|monster remains]]. Aside from crafting, which required time, it was possible to buy all oils at [[Thorstein]]'s shop. Root (2) | align="center" |60 |} == POST-1.2.0 == Besides [[The Witcher Monster Slayer ingredients|monster remains]] and [[The Witcher Monster Slayer ingredients|herbs]], crafting required a store-bought base - [[bear fat]]. Crafting materials were made more difficult to obtain, as common [[The Witcher Monster Slayer bestiary|monsters]] dropped only [[powdered monster tissue]] while rare and legendaries dropped [[The Witcher Monster Slayer ingredients|monster remains]]. Crafting time was reduced. It was possible to buy oils, [[bear fat]] and [[The Witcher Monster Slayer ingredients|a bundle of herbs]] at [[Thorstein]]'s shop.
